saints.name: St. Francis de Sales
saints.title: Bishop and Doctor of the Church
saints.shortBlurb: The gentle bishop of Geneva who taught that holiness is for everyone and won souls back by patience and love…
biography: Born in Savoy in 1567, Francis de Sales gave up a promising career in law and the world to become a priest, and spent years winning the people of the Chablais back from Calvinism, more by kindness and printed tracts than by argument. He was made bishop of Geneva, residing at Annecy.

His books, the Introduction to the Devout Life and the Treatise on the Love of God, taught that the call to holiness belongs to people in every walk of life, and with St. Jane Frances de Chantal he founded the Visitation Order. He died in 1622 and was named a Doctor of the Church.
saints.knownFor: Teaching that holiness is possible for everyone.

canonization.canonized: 1665 by Pope Alexander VII; Doctor of the Church (1877)
